Story

A small place with a big love for good coffee.

[SAMPLE COPY] Zuzuki started with a simple idea: make a corner where the coffee is honest, the food is made fresh and nobody is in a hurry.

[SAMPLE COPY] Today it is a neighbourhood meeting spot for early risers, late-night talkers and everyone in between.

Fresh every day
Beans, milk and bread sourced close by and used while they are at their best.
Slow on purpose
Every cup is brewed to order. No rushing the good stuff.
Always welcome
Come alone, with friends or with a laptop. There is a seat for you.
